results.title: Donald Glover to star, write and direct live-action 'PUBG' series
results.description: Netflix is diving into the world of gaming with a live-action adaptation of the iconic video game ‘PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds.’ The talented Donald Glover will not only take on a lead role but also serve as writer and executive producer.
